steps.say: **+ New class** opens the panel where a class is made. Nothing is created by opening it, so you can look and close it again.
The **Course** box is the one that matters here. Type a few letters and it searches the whole catalogue rather than making you scroll a list.
Pick the language the class is learning. That choice decides what the class practises and what students hear when they join.
The course stays with the class once it is made. A class that needs a different language is a new class, which leaves the old one's records untouched.
steps.terminal: That's choosing what a class learns — one box, searched, and set for good. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
